tasks.title: Conversation #65
tasks.transcript:
Man: Did you end up seeing that movie yesterday with your friend?
Woman: Yes, It was a good way to spend some time with her. It was an afternoon show and the place was practically empty.
Man:How was the movie?
Woman: It was okay. There were lots of unexpected twists, but It was too long.
Man: Should I see it?
Woman: I'm not sure I'd pay money to see it in the theater. Just wait a few months and it will be out on streaming.
Man: That's usually how I watch movies these days anyway.

questions.stem: How did the woman watch the movie?

options.C: With a friend in a theater

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 女士是怎么看的这部电影？ 定位原文: Woman: "It was an afternoon show and the place was practically empty." / Man:"I'm not sure I'd pay money to see it in the theater." 选项分析: A. At home on television (在家看电视) - 错误。女士建议男士等流媒体上线，说明她自己是在影院看的。 B. Streaming on her computer (在电脑上流媒体播放) - 错误。同上，流媒体是未来的建议。 C. With a friend in a theater (和朋友在电影院) - 正确。女士提到 "afternoon show"（下午场）和 "place was practically empty"（地方几乎空无一人），且前文提到和朋友一起，语境指向电影院。 D. On an airplane (在飞机上) - 错误。文中未提及。

questions.stem: Which of these words best describes the woman's opinion of the movie?
questions.analysis: 答案: A 题目问的是: 下列哪个词最能描述女士对这部电影的看法？ 定位原文: Woman: "It was okay. There were lots of unexpected twists, but It was too long." / "I'm not sure I'd pay money to see it in the theater." 选项分析: A. Indifferent (冷漠的/无感的/一般的) - 正确。女士评价 "It was okay"（还行/一般），且不愿意花钱去影院看，说明她对该电影没有强烈的喜爱或厌恶，态度比较平淡。 B. Fascinated (着迷的) - 错误。如果着迷，她会强烈推荐去影院观看。 C. Disgusted (厌恶的) - 错误。她说电影有 "unexpected twists"（意想不到的转折），并没有表现出恶心或极度反感。 D. Puzzled (困惑的) - 错误。虽然电影有转折，但女士的评价很清晰，并未表现出困惑。
